keyFindings.harnessDivergence: Production LoadConfig() -> ConfigStore.LoadAsync() CALLS InstanceService.EnsureDefaultInstance (ConfigStore.cs:153). The test harness installs RouteTestMemoryConfigStore whose Load() returns the in-memory object and BYPASSES it. Measured: harness count=0 vs production-like count=1 after removing the last instance. So the existing green test Remove_LastInstance_LeavesEmptyListAndBlankSelection reflects the HARNESS, not production.
keyFindings.danglingSelection: EnsureDefaultInstance does NOT repair a stale SelectedInstanceId: the guard is if (GetSelectedInstance(config) == null) and GetSelectedInstance falls back to the first instance, so the branch never fires. Consequence: GET /api/instances returns config.SelectedInstanceId verbatim (LocalApiService.cs:1117), so a config corrupted by another path yields a dangling id in the UI. Bounded: the delete path itself DOES re-point (HandleDeleteInstanceAsync 1264-1266). Registered as A17; not changed (behaviour decision).

selfFoundIssues: my new test class lacked [Collection("LocalApiService")] so it ran in parallel with other LocalApiService tests and broke 8 unrelated tests (ModReplacementTests 4, InstanceRunningGuardTests 3, InstanceRemovalTests 1). Fixed by adding the attribute.

I piped dotnet build output to Out-Null and ignored its exit code while the build was actually FAILING (missing using System.Text.Json), so subsequent dotnet test --no-build runs tested a STALE binary - the 5-run and 8-run loops were invalid evidence. Fixed by adding the using and checking the build exit code explicitly. This is the THIRD occurrence of this error class this session.

I had introduced a FLAKY test in round 33: it faked expiry by string-replacing CreatedAt.ToString("O"), but JSON serialization drops trailing zeros, so the replacement silently missed ~10% of the time. Fixed by rewriting createdAt at the JSON level; now 10/10 pass.
